title: 87% OF
LANKANS
DON'T TRAIN.
slides.box: 87% of adults do no sport or fitness at all. WHO STEPS Sri Lanka, 2021.

title: YOUR MUSCLE
EATS SEENI.
slides.body: Research finds South Asians tend to carry less muscle, and low muscle is linked to higher diabetes risk. Alkhayl et al., Sci Rep, 2022 (small study).

title: LOWER RISK.
slides.body: 30-60 mins of strength work a week. Shorter than your bus ride to Fort. Linked to less early death, heart disease, cancer and diabetes. Momma et al., BJSM, 2022 (observational).

title: 10 MINS.
3 DAYS.
slides.body: That's your 30 mins. Do it before the kottu.

caption:
Machan, 87% of Sri Lankan adults do no sport or fitness at all. Meanwhile seeni and pressure are running the family WhatsApp group.

The fix doesn't need a gym, a contract or even electricity. 10 minutes of push-ups, 3 days a week. Start on the wall if you have to. Nobody's judging except Amma.

Tag the machan who's been starting "from Monday" since the last World Cup.

Sources: WHO STEPS Sri Lanka 2021; Momma et al., BJSM 2022; Alkhayl et al., Sci Rep 2022. These show links, not guarantees. Got a heart condition or high pressure? Check with your doctor first.
